title: [Lean] Prove prefix register invariants for the PR628 word model
body:
PR1294's universal phase identities rely on four source/target invariants whose connection to the recursive word remained informal. This adds a Lean 4.28.0 proof of those invariants for the raw-address PR628 word model: every finite binary factor tree, every completed-leaf prefix, both signs, and shared deeper scratch. It extends the existing completed-call nonlinear formalization with prefix semantics. **Status: scoped formalization and independent verification; no new kappa.**

The proof establishes source preservation, target-translation equivariance, zero-preserving axis invariance, finite scratch bounds, and the four local phase conditions. Inverse-map conditions remain explicit premises. All seven audited theorems use only `propext` and `Quot.sound`; no placeholders, custom axioms or native evaluation oracle are used.

The source connection is deliberately bounded: an authenticated AST extraction of the unchanged dispatcher, 132 source executions / 66 distinct signed traces at counts 1–32 and 75, and 18 fresh kernel-checked equalities to the literal traces at counts 1–8 and 75. The package also checks 147,384 exact matrix row/column obligations, nonlinear dirty-prefix cases, 19 negative controls and six source/receipt/relocation tests. It does not claim a formal proof of Python semantics, the squarefree factor-support induction, numerical leaves, precision, physical admission or the multiplication theorem.

Reproduce with Python 3.12+ and official Lean 4.28.0:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/dirty-dispatcher-invariants-seed75/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_DISPATCHER_INVARIANTS formal=7 kernel_traces=18 python_traces=66 controls=19 kappa=unchanged`.

Full local Lean/Python 3.12 replay, six package tests, all 20 research onboarding tests and selected-record integrity pass. The registered generic replay explicitly reports `Lean=NOT_RUN`; a separate scoped workflow downloads the checksum-pinned Lean release and runs the full proof check. Hosted CI is separate from local validation.

Base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`. OS assignment seed: **75**, independent-verification track. Source: PR628 `0768f97d06c623b8211e651543c66135796b62bf`, retained byte-identically on main. PR1278 `06b8c006891ae78abe24b30d2fe9d8c188deafe8` and PR1294 `03025ca1d51091a9525203000e77dacccfa6a70d` were unchanged on refresh. Full overlap coverage at 02:17 UTC included 773 open PRs and 199 discussion records; no matching scope was found, which is not proof of novelty. No pinned sprint issue existed, so the claim is local in TASK.json.

Only the new research package and its scoped workflow are added. The selected frontier and frozen inputs remain unchanged. The README contains the exact scope, source pins, evidence, predecessor distinctions and open next questions.

Prepared by **Hanson Sun (@bbMisk)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in proofs, implementation, checks and writing; no independent human review is claimed. Credit Chafik Boukhalfa (PR628/905), Charles Bethin (PR1278), Philipp / mightyOil (PR1294), Gareth Davidson / bitplane (the retained nonlinear formalization and PR877), 0xkilgore (PR663), and the retained upstream lineage. Apache-2.0; existing source notices are unchanged.
